Probiotic-rich, packed with iron, calcium, fiber & essential nutrients—perfect for weight loss & digestion ❤️ Light, satisfying & ideal for all ages, especially in summer ✨ Recipe: 🌿 Mix 2 tbsp ragi flour with 1 cup water to make a smooth slurry. In a pan, heat 2 cups water. Once it starts boiling, add the slurry and cook on medium flame till it thickens. Keep stirring continuously to avoid lumps. Let it cool completely. 🌿 In a bowl, add 1 cup fresh curd, 2–3 cups water, salt to taste, ¼ cup finely chopped onion, and 2 tbsp coriander leaves. Add the cooled ragi porridge and mix well. 🌿 Prepare the tadka: heat 1 tsp oil or ghee, add ½ tsp cumin seeds + mustard seeds, grated ginger, green chili, curry leaves, and a pinch of hing. Pour over the kanji. Enjoy! #ragimillet #raagikanji  #guthealth #healthybreakfast #milletrecipes

Here’s my travel guide for visiting Mt. Rigi the "Queen of the Mountains." Mount Rigi near Lucerne, Switzerland is home to Europe’s oldest mountain railway so getting to the summit by cogwheel train is half the magic. 🚂How to get to Mount Rigi - all completely FREE with your Swiss Travel Pass! ➡️ From Lucerne: boat across Lake Lucerne to Vitznau, then cogwheel train to the top in just 30 minutes ➡️ From Zurich: train to Arth-Goldau, then cogwheel train to Rigi Kulm in under an hour 🚠 Or take the cable car from Weggis to Rigi Kaltbad in just 10 minutes 🗺️ Check the online timetables before you go 🛏️ Where to stay on Mount Rigi Check into @hotelrigikaltbad 1,450m above sea level, with panoramic mountain views and a mineral spa fed straight from the mountain springs. Day passes to the spa are available, but nothing beats an early morning on Mt. Rigi waking up above the clouds, hearing cowbells at sunrise, and finishing with a dip in the mineral water. ✨Things to do on Mount Rigi 🇨🇭Visit the summit Rigi Kulm 🇨🇭Hike the Lake Views Trail from Rigi Kulm to Rigi Staffelhöhe 🇨🇭 Lunch at Michelin-starred Regina Montium @kraeuterhoteledelweiss 🇨🇭 Catch sunset at the Känzeli viewpoint 🇨🇭 Soak in mountain views from every angle 🇨🇭 Dip in the mineral spa at @mineralbadrigikaltbad Your ultimate Mount Rigi Switzerland travel guide - save it, share it, and add it to your Switzerland bucket list! 🏔️ Filmed on an ad-press trip  ———————————————— Rigi, Mt Rigi, Mount Rigi, Mount Rigi Switzerland, Lucerne, Luzern, Lucerne Switzerland, Lucerne food, bucket list, food bucket list, viral food, content creator, travel Switzerland, travel blog, travel foodie, travel in Europe, visit Switzerland, my Switzerland, best places to visit in Switzerland, Switzerland mountain, Michelin Star restaurant, Lucerne restaurants, things to do Lucerne #switzerland  #lucerne #rigi #travelswitzerland #luzern

#creatorsearchinsights #fypシ゚viral__  Sejarah Ragi  Simak penjelasan lengkap nya dibawah: Sejarah Ragi: Dari Kuno ke Modern 1. Zaman Kuno – Dipake tanpa tau namanya   - 7000–6000 SM: Mesopotamia & Mesir Kuno bikin bir & roti pake ragi liar dari udara. - 2000 SM: Cina udah fermentasi arak beras & kecap pake ragi herbal. - Nusantara: Tape & brem muncul dari teknik fermentasi Cina-India. Ragi dibikin dari beras + rempah. 2.  Tokoh Penemu/Perintis Ragi 1. Antonie van Leeuwenhoek (1680): Pertama liat sel ragi pake mikroskop. Dia nyebut "animalcules" tapi belum tau fungsinya.   2. Louis Pasteur (1857): Buktiin fermentasi itu kerja mikroorganisme hidup. Dia jelasin peran Saccharomyces cerevisiae → bapak mikrobiologi.   3. Theodor Schwann (1837): Ahli fisiologi Jerman yang nyebut ragi sebagai tumbuhan hidup & penyebab fermentasi alkohol. Dia salah satu pencetus "teori sel". Sebelum Pasteur, Schwann udah bilang fermentasi = proses biologis, bukan kimia biasa. 3. Perkembangan Kuno → Modern Kuno:   - Ragi liar, hasil ga konsisten   - Ragi tape/arak dibikin manual dari bahan alam Modern:   - 1870-an: Ragi basah pabrikan mulai dipake   - 1940-an: Ragi kering instan populer pas PD II   - Sekarang: Strain ragi diisolasi & direkayasa di lab buat roti, bir, bioetanol, sampe obat Schwann + Pasteur ngebuktiin ragi itu makhluk hidup, bukan "sihir". Sejak itu manusia bisa ngontrol fermentasi.#kapanfyp #fandex #bismillahfyp
